evidence_articles.title: Congress promises ₹72,000 per annum to poorest people
evidence_articles.rephrased: The article covers Rahul Gandhi's announcement of the NYAY minimum income guarantee scheme, which promises to directly transfer ₹72,000 per year to the bank accounts of India's poorest 20% families.
evidence_articles.content: Congress president Rahul Gandhi on Monday announced a minimum income guarantee scheme, Nyuntam Aay Yojana (NYAY), under which ₹72,000 a year will be transferred to the bank accounts of 20% of the poorest families in the country if his party is voted to power.

recent_articles.title: Lodhi Crematorium wall collapse: As a labourer dies, a family loses its home | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A boundary wall and storage room collapsed at the Lodhi Crematorium in Delhi during construction work, killing one laborer and injuring two others. **PWD** workers were using a JCB and Hydra machine for excavation and pipe-laying when the incident occurred at 1:08 am.  The deceased laborer was identified as Rahul Kharwan, while injured laborers Rajesh (48) and Umar (20) are receiving treatment. The police, fire department, and ambulance personnel conducted a joint rescue operation before securing the site.

recent_articles.title: Minister Ramalinga Reddy’s resignation issue resolved, says Chief Minister Shivakumar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, **Karnataka Chief Minister**, resolved a crisis triggered by **Ramalinga Reddy's** resignation over portfolio allocation after marathon discussions with the senior Congress leader.  The meeting, lasting nearly two-and-a-half hours, involved senior Congress leaders and some of **Reddy's** close associates.  **Shivakumar** stated that the issue was a case of miscommunication and assured that everything would be sorted out.

recent_articles.title: PM Narendra Modi: Congress spread chaos, its parasitic politics won’t work | Ahmedabad News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** addressed a public meeting in Surat, Gujarat, where he criticized the **Congress** for "spreading chaos and uncertainty" and highlighted the people's dissatisfaction with their governance. He emphasized India's energy self-reliance efforts since 2014, citing increased investments in renewable energy and securing oil and gas supplies from various parts of the world.  The Prime Minister also addressed the global crisis caused by the West Asia conflict, emphasizing India's resilience in facing challenges like fluctuating petrol prices and disrupted supply chains. **Kamal Saiyed**, a senior correspondent for The Indian Express, provides extensive coverage on industrial, social, and political developments in Surat and the surrounding region.

recent_articles.title: Can Supriya Life Sciences unlock its next leg of growth beyond APIs? | Smart Stocks News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Supriya Life Sciences**, an API manufacturer, is transitioning from a traditional API business to a broader pharmaceutical player. The company focuses on products where Chinese manufacturers dominate supply, positioning itself as an alternative supplier for regulated markets.  This strategy includes expanding into formulations, contrast media APIs, and contract manufacturing services. While the Ambernath facility represents a significant expansion, Supriya's growth is driven by multiple initiatives rather than a single project. The company faces execution risks related to commercialization timelines, customer qualification, and competition from Chinese manufacturers. Investors are evaluating Supriya based on its existing API business but will need to assess the success of these new initiatives in the coming years.

recent_articles.title: NIA Arrests Ex-Trinamool MLA Saokat Molla In Bhangar Blast Case
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Investigation Agency (NIA)** arrested former Trinamool Congress MLA Saokat Molla, a prime suspect in the Bhangar bomb blast case, from West Bengal's South 24 Parganas district.  Molla was declared 'absconding' earlier this week after the agency conducted searches at his residence and other locations linked to him. The arrest brings the total number of individuals held in connection with the case to four. Molla will be produced before a court tomorrow, and further legal proceedings will follow.

recent_articles.title: Farah Khan stunned by Terence Lewis' surreal Salvador Dalí bathroom, throne-like commode
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Terence Lewis**, a celebrity choreographer and reality show judge, recently gave **Farah Khan**, a filmmaker-choreographer, a tour of his opulent Mumbai house. The home features luxurious yet elegant decor elements like metallic accents on the entrance door, plush seating in white and beige tones, and a black piano.  **Ishitta Arun**, an artisan from Jaipur, sourced an antique-style door with detailed carvings for the living space. **Farah Khan** joked that the bathroom resembled a set from a Sanjay Leela Bhansali film, inspired by the surreal, molten-style basin designed by **Terence Lewis** in homage to **Salvador Dalí**.  The tour also included a cozy study and a kitchen with a striking chandelier made of tea kettles.

recent_articles.title: TMC parliamentary split ‘just a matter of time’: As Mamata fights back, cracks grow | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee** is facing growing dissent within the **Trinamool Congress (TMC)**, with 60 of its 80 MLAs in West Bengal signaling rebellion.  Senior TMC leader Sukhendu Sekhar Roy believes a similar reaction could occur in the Lok Sabha, where the party has 28 MPs and faces potential defections under anti-defection laws. The rebel faction is seeking to retain **Mamata Banerjee** as chairperson of the party, while others within the party are calling for her removal from leadership positions.  The situation remains fluid with some rebels expressing a desire to remain under **Mamata Banerjee's** leadership but disagreeing with Abhishek Banerjee's role as national general secretary.

recent_articles.title: Penguin pulls plug on Joe Sacco’s book on Muzaffarnagar riots | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Penguin Random House India** has pulled the distribution of Joe Sacco's graphic novel, "The Once and Future Riot," which chronicles the 2013 Muzaffarnagar communal clashes. The publisher cited concerns about an inaccurate map and content questions raised during legal scrutiny.  While the book is available online through UK-based wholesalers, some South Delhi bookstores have imported copies directly from the UK. **Ritu Sarin**, Executive Editor (News and Investigations) at **The Indian Express** group, has been involved in investigative journalism on topics like offshore leaks and corruption.

recent_articles.title: Ramalinga Reddy resigns from Ministry, says he is ‘humiliated’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ramalinga Reddy**, a senior Congress legislator from Bengaluru, resigned after being denied the **Bengaluru Development** portfolio by **Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar**.  He stated that he would not personally submit his resignation but would do so through an official channel.  Reddy, who has been influential in East and North Bengaluru, expressed disappointment over the decision and claimed a promise made by **Shivakumar** to give him the portfolio was broken. Supporters of Reddy staged protests in his constituency.  Former Law and Parliamentary Affairs Minister H.K. Patil urged leaders to address the issue justly.

recent_articles.title: Kharge files nomination papers for Rajya Sabha polls from Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **All India Congress Committee**, filed his nomination papers for the Rajya Sabha election from Karnataka, accompanied by **Rahul Gandhi**. The other two candidates are **Mansoor Ali Khan** and **Pawan Khera**.  The elections will be held on June 18th with the Congress party expected to secure three seats. Discussions regarding portfolio allocation among ministers were reportedly underway during a car ride.

recent_articles.title: Khandre says ensuring clean drinking water to rural areas is his priority - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Eshwar Khandre**, the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister, has identified ensuring clean drinking water access for rural areas as his top priority.  He met with **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the AICC president, in Bengaluru and stated a long-term vision to provide surface water for drinking purposes over the next 25 years. Khandre also emphasized maintaining village cleanliness, improving infrastructure, and protecting water sources like ponds. He began his tenure by meeting with department officials on Saturday.

recent_articles.title: Great Nicobar project meant to benefit Adani, it’s not about defence: Rahul Gandhi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, criticized the **BJP**’s claim that the Great Nicobar Island project is strategic, alleging it's a ploy to benefit industrialist **Gautam Adani**.  Gandhi launched an online petition urging citizens to join his campaign titled “we choose green over greed,” highlighting concerns about ecological destruction and displacement of local communities. He argued that expanding the naval air station INS Baaz would be a more appropriate strategic move, while accusing the government of prioritizing commercial interests over environmental protection. **Mallikarjun Kharge**, Congress president, echoed these sentiments, criticizing the government's environmental record and deforestation rates.  Gandhi called for sustainable development in Great Nicobar, contrasting it with the proposed project that he believes would harm the island’s environment and indigenous communities.

recent_articles.title: US Court Strikes Down Trump Policies Targeting Immigrants From 39 Countries
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A federal judge ruled that the **US Department of Homeland Security** (DHS) and its **US Citizenship and Immigration Services** (USCIS) violated immigration laws by implementing unlawful policies that barred people from 39 countries from receiving decisions on asylum, work permits, green cards, and citizenship.  The ruling was issued by Chief US District Judge John McConnell in Providence, Rhode Island, who found the USCIS's hold on processing applications to be arbitrary and based on "anti-immigrant sentiments." The judge emphasized that these individuals had adhered to legal processes and were not at fault for the delays. This victory for immigrant service organizations and labor unions was hailed as a reaffirmation of the principle that the federal government cannot discriminate against people based on their origin.

recent_articles.title: In Haryana, suspended Congress MLA’s husband joins BJP, hits out at Hooda | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rishipal**, husband of **Haryana Congress MLA Renu Bala**, joined the **BJP** on Friday, welcomed by **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini**.  **Renu Bala**, who was suspended from the Congress in April for allegedly cross-voting in the Rajya Sabha polls, has been seen attending state government programs alongside BJP leaders. She maintains her membership in the Assembly but could face disqualification if she formally joins another party. **Rishipal** accused senior Congress leader **Bhupinder Singh Hooda** of falsely claiming that his wife had cross-voted and claimed that the Congress prioritizes power over development.

recent_articles.title: Four months after Ajit Pawar’s death, rival NCP factions to hold separate foundation day events | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) factions, led by Sharad Pawar and Sunetra Ajit Pawar, will hold separate foundation day events in Mumbai on June 10th.  **Sunil Tatkare**, NCP state president and MP, announced the celebrations for the faction led by **Sharad Pawar**. The Sharad Pawar-led faction will celebrate its foundation day with a meeting of INDIA bloc constituents on June 8th under the theme "Loyalty to ideology, dedication to people". Both factions have continued to observe June 10th as their foundation day following Ajit Pawar's death in January.

recent_articles.title: Himanta Sarma expands Assam Cabinet, balances new faces and loyalists, groups and regions | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Sarma**, Assam's Chief Minister, expanded his cabinet to 17 members on Friday. The new ministers include several former Congress leaders who joined the BJP with **Sarma**, such as Ajanta Neog and Pijush Hazarika, along with Sushanta Borgohain, Biswajit Daimary, Ranoj Pegu, and Rameshwar Teli.  The cabinet also includes representatives from Southern Assam's Barak Valley and the Koch Rajbongshi community. The expansion reflects a balance between new faces and loyalists, while maintaining representation from various regions and communities within Assam.

recent_articles.title: In Who-Is-Real-Trinamool Fight, Pushback Planned Against Ritabrata Banerjee
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**'s faction of the **Trinamool Congress** is challenging the Speaker's recognition of **Ritabrata Banerjee** as the new Leader of the Opposition. The faction is also attempting to reintegrate rebel MLAs into the original party fold.  Senior MLA Soven Deb Chatterjee has stated that many rebels are returning to the original Trinamool fold, rejecting **Ritabrata Banerjee**'s list of rebels. Meanwhile, a group of loyalists met at **Mamata Banerjee**'s house and reaffirmed their support for her leadership.

recent_articles.title: US judge invalidates travel and visa ban on 39 countries: What happens next? - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A US federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's immigration ban on 39 countries, imposed after a shooting in Washington DC last November, was unlawful. **USCIS** adopted policies targeting immigrants from those countries, creating legal uncertainty for countless individuals living in the United States. The ruling found that these policies violated immigration laws and administrative rules.  The Department of Homeland Security has not yet commented on the decision, which allows the administration to appeal or request a stay of the verdict.

recent_articles.title: US judge invalidates travel and visa ban on 39 countries: What happens next? - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A US federal judge ruled that the **Donald Trump** administration's immigration ban on 39 countries, imposed after a shooting in Washington D.C., was unlawful.  **USCIS**, under the Obama-appointed Judge John McConnell, adopted policies targeting individuals from those countries, creating legal limbo for countless immigrants living in the US. The judge found that these policies violated immigration laws and administrative rules, stating that they were "neither 'followed the law' nor 'done things the right way.'"  The **Department of Homeland Security** has not yet responded to the ruling.

recent_articles.title: Hooch deaths: ‘Perfect case of government negligence; what was learned from 2015 Malwani liquor tragedy?’ asks Congress | Pune News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the deaths of over 20 people in Pune due to spurious liquor, **the Maharashtra government** has penalized 26 officials and employees. However, the **Congress party**, led by Sachin Sawant, criticized this action as insufficient and demanded accountability for past recommendations made after a similar tragedy in Malwani in 2015. The committee's recommendations included stricter control over methanol production and transportation, increased police and excise department campaigns against illegal liquor manufacturing, information sharing between departments, and strict enforcement of regulations. Sawant questioned the government's commitment to implementing these recommendations and demanded transparency regarding their status. He also highlighted the lack of preparedness in hospitals and the ease with which accused individuals were granted bail, emphasizing the need for stricter action against organized crime involved in illegal liquor trade.

recent_articles.title: Unocoin Bitcoin theft case: Karnataka Police SIT names Congress MLA N A Haris’s son in chargesheet | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mohammed Nalapad**, a youth Congress leader, and his brother **Omar Nalapad**, along with hacker **Sriki** and his accountant **Robin Khandelwal**, are named in a chargesheet filed by the **Karnataka Police** for the theft of Bitcoin worth Rs 1.14 crore from the Unocoin crypto exchange in 2017. The investigation, which began in 2023, is linked to multiple cases involving stolen cryptocurrency and money laundering.  The ED has also arrested Sriki, Khandelwal, and associate **Sunish Hegde** for allegedly laundering funds obtained through hacking various online systems between 2017 and 2020. The investigation is ongoing.

recent_articles.title: Only 8 MLAs, 6 MPs At Mamata Banerjee's Home For Key Meet. Party Clarifies
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Only eight **Trinamool Congress** MLAs attended a National Working Committee meeting at former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee's Kalighat house in Kolkata, following a rebellion within the party.  The party clarified that not all MPs and MLAs were invited, with only four Lok Sabha MPs and two Rajya Sabha MPs present. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata Banerjee's nephew, was among those who attended. Rebel MLA **Ritabrata Banerjee** stated that more MLAs will join the rebellion, increasing the number of supporters beyond 2/3rd of the party.

recent_articles.title: Trump Sees Win As US Senate Approves $70 Billion For Immigration Crackdown
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US Senate** approved $70 billion in funding for Donald Trump's hardline immigration crackdown, marking a victory for the Republican leader. The bill, which funds Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Border Patrol through the remainder of Trump's term, passed after a contentious vote-a-rama process that highlighted internal Republican divisions.  The legislation now heads to the **House of Representatives**, where Republicans hope to move it quickly to President Trump's desk.

recent_articles.title: India Reports GDP Growth Of 7.8% In Q4 On Services Sector Output Boost
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** real GDP grew 7.8% year-on-year in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, exceeding market expectations and contributing to full-year growth of 7.7%. The secondary and tertiary sectors drove this growth, with the secondary sector expanding 8.8% and the tertiary sector growing 9.3%.  **The BJP** praised these figures, calling them a testament to India's economic strength while **Rahul Gandhi**, a Congress leader, warned of an "economic tsunami."

recent_articles.title: First resignation in 2-day-old DKS cabinet, Ramalinga Reddy resigns over portfolio | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ramalinga Reddy**, **Karnataka**'s Minister, resigned after being denied the **Bengaluru Development** portfolio.  He had previously requested this position and was offered the **Water Resources** portfolio as a compromise. **D K Shivakumar**, the Chief Minister, allocated portfolios to his 13 ministers, including **Priyank Kharge** as Home Minister and **Dr G Parameshwara** as Revenue Minister.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka Cabinet portfolios row emerges after Shivakumar Government swearing-in | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Newly elected **Karnataka** Chief Minister D K Shivakumar is facing challenges in allocating portfolios to his cabinet.  **Ramalinga Reddy**, a newly inducted minister, reportedly resigned after not being allocated the Bengaluru Development portfolio, which he had sought. Sources suggest that attempts were made to appease **Reddy** with other ministerial positions, but ultimately, **Krishna Byre Gowda** was chosen for the role. Other ministers are also reported to have expressed dissatisfaction with their assigned portfolios.

recent_articles.title: BJP names Rajya Sabha candidates for five States; two Union Ministers left out - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** announced its candidates for the upcoming Rajya Sabha polls in five states.  The party nominated several younger leaders, including Rajubhai Shukla, Mukeshbhai Rathwa, Mansingh Parmar, and Jitendra Meghjibhai Kanzariya from Gujarat; Tarun Chugh and Rajneesh Agrawal from Madhya Pradesh; Alka Gurjar and Satish Poonia from Rajasthan; A. Sharda Devi from Manipur; and Tai Tagak from Arunachal Pradesh.  The party also accommodated Debashish Samantaray, who recently joined the BJP after leaving his seat in the Rajya Sabha as a Biju Janata Dal (BJD) MP. The Rajya Sabha polls will be held on June 18.

recent_articles.title: Bidhannagar Corporation Mayor resigns a day after Kolkata Corporation Mayor quit - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Krishna Chakraborty**, the **Bidhannagar Municipality Corporation** Mayor, resigned on Thursday (June 4, 2026), citing personal reasons. **Chakraborty** has served as a councillor for 16 years and stated she will continue to work in that capacity.  Her resignation comes after **Firhad Hakim**, the former **Kolkata Municipal Corporation** mayor, submitted his resignation on Wednesday (June 3, 2026). The West Bengal government criticized both resignations, calling them irresponsible and lacking accountability. The KMC elections are scheduled for December 2026.

recent_articles.title: Mahayuti likely to win six MLC seats unopposed - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** witnessed a significant shift in the legislative council polls with several candidates withdrawing their nominations, paving the way for Mahayuti to secure six unopposed seats. **NCP** candidate Aniket Tatkare is likely to win uncontested in Ratnagiri after **Bal Mane**, a Shiv Sena (UBT) candidate, withdrew his nomination.  The withdrawal of other candidates from various constituencies also contributed to this outcome. The Election Commission of India will hold the elections on June 18th with results expected on June 22nd.

recent_articles.title: US House Approves Billions In Aid To Ukraine, Impose Sanctions On Russia
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US House of Representatives** passed legislation providing over $1 billion in security and reconstruction aid to Ukraine, including $8 billion in loans for defense. The bill, sponsored by Rep. Gregory Meeks, was supported by 207 Democrats and one independent, while 18 Republicans voted against it.  Republican leaders expressed concerns that the bill undermines negotiations with **President Donald Trump** and could lead to decreased defense spending. The legislation now heads to the Senate, where its fate remains uncertain.

recent_articles.title: Congress Betrayed By Supporting TVK, Will Never Forget: Udhayanidhi Stalin
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Udhayanidhi Stalin**, leader of the **DMK**, accused the **Congress** of betraying the party by supporting Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) after the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections. He stated that elected Congress MLAs have not maintained contact with DMK leadership and criticized the Congress for failing to inform the DMK on key matters despite other alliance partners providing updates. This accusation has intensified tensions between the **DMK** and **Congress**, leading the **DMK** to skip the INDIA bloc meeting scheduled for June 8th in New Delhi.

recent_articles.title: Safeguards sought against misuse of menstrual leave in schools - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. Prathibha**, a medical officer from Tanur, has written to **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** urging the government to implement strict guidelines and mandatory medical certification for schoolgirls seeking menstrual leave.  Dr. Prathibha suggests that students experiencing severe physical or psychological difficulties during menstruation should be granted leave based on an annual certificate issued by a government female doctor, and that requests be handled by a female teacher.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi slams ‘broken system’ for NEET aspirant’s death - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Lok Sabha's** Opposition, criticized the **Narendra Modi government** following the death of Akanksha Chaturvedi, a NEET aspirant from Madhya Pradesh.  The 18-year-old reportedly died by suicide after allegedly being overwhelmed by depression due to the cancellation of the May 3 exam and allegations of a paper leak.  Gandhi accused the **Prime Minister** of creating a "corrupt and broken" education system and called for concrete action beyond committees and inquiries. The **National Testing Agency**, which conducted the NEET (UG) 2026 examination, is investigating the matter.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka cabinet portfolios allocated, but disgruntlement remains - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mr. Shivakumar**, the newly sworn-in **Karnataka** Chief Minister, allocated portfolios to his cabinet on Thursday (June 5, 2026).  The most contested portfolio, Bengaluru Development, was given to **Krishna Byre Gowda**. Senior Minister **Ramalinga Reddy** received Major and Medium Irrigation. **Priyank Kharge** will be the new Home Minister, while **G. Parameshwara** has been assigned Revenue and Sports. **Eshwar Khandre** is in charge of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj, and **Byrathi Suresh** holds Transport.  The allocation of Bengaluru Development portfolio remains a contentious issue.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka cabinet portfolios allocated, but disgruntlement remains - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mr. Shivakumar**, the newly-sworn in **Karnataka** Chief Minister, allocated portfolios to his cabinet on Thursday after a day of negotiations and discontent among some ministers.  **Krishna Byre Gowda** received the coveted Bengaluru Development portfolio previously held by Mr. Shivakumar. **Ramalinga Reddy**, who had sought the portfolio, was given Major and Medium Irrigation. Other key changes included **Priyank Kharge** as Home Minister and **G. Parameshwara** as Revenue and Sports Minister. The allocation of the Bengaluru Development portfolio is likely to remain a contentious issue in the lead-up to upcoming civic polls.

recent_articles.title: Bid to rename Barkatullah University as ‘Vagdevi Bhojpal University’ sparks political row in Bhopal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **executive council** of **Bhopal’s Barkatullah University** voted to rename the institution to ‘Vagdevi Bhopal University’, prompting criticism from opposition parties. The resolution, which honors the goddess Vagdevi and the city's ancient name Bhojpal, was passed unanimously and sent to the Governor for approval.  The move has been met with strong objections from Congress MLA Arif Masood and the CPI-M who view it as an insult to freedom fighters.  A senior university official denied that there were any serious demands to change the name but acknowledged issues facing the institution such as delayed salaries and poor infrastructure.

recent_articles.title: What is this stupid game?: Modi on IND players' reactions to inaugural T20 WC
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lalit Modi**, former **IPL** chairperson, recalled his efforts to convince Indian cricketers in 2007 to participate in the inaugural T20 World Cup.  He stated that players initially dismissed the format as a "stupid game" due to fatigue and family commitments. Despite this skepticism, India went on to win the tournament, which led to the birth of the IPL a year later. **Modi** questioned whether the public, players, administrators, and BCCI would accept a second-string team for future World Cups, arguing that such a move would face widespread disapproval.

recent_articles.title: Kharge and Praveen Chakravarty among Congress Rajya Sabha nominees - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** announced seven candidates for the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections on June 18th, across five states.  The party selected **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Pawan Khera**, and **Mansoor Ali Khan** from Karnataka, **Praveen Chakravarty** from Tamil Nadu, **Meenakshi Natarajan** in Madhya Pradesh, **Pranav Jha** in Jharkhand, and **Neeraj Dangi** in Rajasthan. The candidates were chosen to represent the party's interests across various states.

recent_articles.title: Kharge and Praveen Chakravarty among Congress Rajya Sabha nominees - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** announced seven candidates for the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections on June 18th, across five states.  The party nominated **Mallikarjun Kharge** from Karnataka, along with Pawan Khera and Mansoor Ali Khan. In Tamil Nadu, **Praveen Chakravarty**, All India Professionals’ Congress chief, was chosen.  In Madhya Pradesh, **Meenakshi Natarajan** was selected, while in Jharkhand, **Pranav Jha** was nominated. Rajasthan's **Neeraj Dangi** will be returning for another term.

recent_articles.title: Delhi Confidential: Top Secret | Delhi Confidential News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Akhilesh Yadav**, president of the **Samajwadi Party**, has instructed party leaders to maintain confidentiality regarding their meetings and discussions, especially with journalists. He also urged probable candidates to begin preparations in their constituencies but keep communication confidential until seat-sharing agreements are finalized with the **Congress**.  The future of the **Cockroach Janta Party**’s protest at Jantar Mantar on Saturday remains uncertain as Delhi Police has begun tracking the group's activities.

recent_articles.title: DK Shivakumar Keeps Finance, Priyank Kharge Is Karnataka's New Home Minister
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar** has retained the finance, cabinet affairs, intelligence, and personnel and administrative reforms portfolios in Karnataka. **G Parameshwara**, the deputy chief minister, will oversee the revenue and sports departments.  **Priyank Kharge**, son of Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge, was given the home department (excluding intelligence) along with IT, biotechnology, and e-Governance responsibilities. Other key portfolios were distributed among 13 other MLAs who took oath as ministers yesterday following Siddaramaiah's resignation.

recent_articles.title: Bengal Ex-Minister's Brother Arrested Over Extortion Charges In Kolkata
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swarup Biswas**, brother of former West Bengal Sports Minister **Aroop Biswas**, was arrested by **Kolkata Police** on Thursday night in connection with allegations of extortion against technicians from the Bengali film industry. The arrest followed a complaint filed by a female make-up artist who alleged that **Swarup Biswas** had conspired to prevent her from receiving makeup assignments and extorted money from her through intimidation.  The case is being investigated at New Alipore Police Station, and **Swarup Biswas** will be produced before a lower court in Kolkata on Friday.

recent_articles.title: Congress Picks Ex-MP, BJP 2 Top Leaders For Rajya Sabha From Madhya Pradesh
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** nominated former Mandsaur MP Meenakshi Natarajan for the Rajya Sabha seat vacated by Digvijaya Singh. The **BJP** has fielded Tarun Chugh and Rajneesh Agarwal, with the potential for a third candidate to influence the closely contested election in Madhya Pradesh.  While the BJP is expected to win two seats comfortably, the Congress appears poised to retain one.

recent_articles.title: Rahul ‘selling panic’, promoting baseless conspiracy theories: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** accused **Rahul Gandhi** of promoting fear and baseless conspiracy theories about the Indian economy and institutions.  **Amit Malviya**, BJP IT Cell head, countered that Mr. Gandhi's claims about an "economic tsunami" and a collapsing system were unfounded. He highlighted India's resilience in the face of global challenges, citing strong reserves, low inflation, and robust economic indicators.

recent_articles.title: Rahul ‘selling panic’, promoting baseless conspiracy theories: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** accused **Rahul Gandhi** of promoting fear and baseless conspiracy theories about India's institutions and economy.  **Amit Malviya**, the BJP's IT Cell head, countered that Mr. Gandhi's claims were unfounded and that the Indian economy was resilient despite global challenges. He cited strong reserves, low inflation, robust infrastructure spending, and record FDI inflows as evidence of India's economic strength.

recent_articles.title: BJP sends Tarun Chugh to Rajya Sabha, fuels speculation over Bittu’s Punjab role | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** nominated Punjab leader Tarun Chugh to the Rajya Sabha from Madhya Pradesh, fueling speculation about the future political role of Union Minister Ravneet Singh Bittu.  Bittu's name was not included in the first list of candidates for the June 18 Rajya Sabha elections despite his desire to return to active politics in Punjab. He also expressed concerns about Mission Bhagiratha's water supply being affected by the new system. **Rao** demanded an Assembly session to address these issues and accused the Congress government of increasing discoms' dues significantly.

recent_articles.title: Ahead of D K Shivakumar’s swearing-in, lobbying grows for deputy CM, Cabinet posts | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the caretaker chief minister of **Karnataka**, is facing pressure from various caste groups to appoint a deputy chief minister.  **Eshwar Khandre**, a Lingayat leader and Forest Minister, has been urged by influential seers to take on this role, while supporters of **G Parameshwara**, a Dalit leader, are demanding his appointment as deputy chief minister. Other names circulating include those of **K H Muniyappa** and **M C Sudhakar**.  The Congress leadership is yet to receive any formal proposals for deputy ministerial positions, with both **Shivakumar** and **Siddaramaiah** expected to travel to Delhi to finalize the Cabinet list.

recent_articles.title: CM Omar calls MLAs meet on June 3
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Omar Abdullah**, the Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, has called a meeting for June 3rd with his ruling **National Conference** MLAs and the four independent legislators supporting his government. recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, former West Bengal Chief Minister and leader of the **Trinamool Congress (TMC)**, will lead protests against alleged assaults on her party MPs.  **Abhishek Banerjee**, nephew and TMC national general secretary, was attacked with eggs and bricks while visiting families affected by post-poll violence in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas district. **Kalyan Banerjee**, Lok Sabha MP from Sreerampur, also reported being assaulted near Chanditala police station while on his way to submit a deputation regarding the violence. recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee to hit the streets on June 2 after attack on Abhishek, TMC leader - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, **TMC** leader, announced a sit-in protest in Kolkata on June 2nd against alleged attacks on party leaders and workers. The protests follow incidents involving **Abhishek Banerjee** and **Kalyan Banerjee**.  The **TMC** plans statewide demonstrations on June 1st at ward, anchal, and block levels.  Following the alleged attacks on **Abhishek Banerjee**, who was assaulted in Sonarpur, West Bengal Police arrested five individuals for heckling him. The **TMC** has condemned these incidents as attempts to suppress dissenting voices and promote violence.

recent_articles.title: 39 Hardinge Road: The Reason Why Rabri Devi Doesn't Want To Vacate Bungalow
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rabri Devi**, former Bihar chief minister, has refused to vacate her 10 Circular Road bungalow in Patna despite an eviction notice from the **Bihar government**. The state government has allocated her a new house on Hardinge Road, but she remains adamant and claims superstition is behind her resistance.  The property has been a symbol of her political career for over two decades and is now being contested by the government.

recent_articles.title: Ramachandra Guha Says Gandhi Family Actions Helped Modi Consolidate Power | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ramachandra Guha**, a historian, argues that the **Gandhi family** and **Congress** insiders have indirectly aided Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**'s power consolidation after the 2024 general election. He acknowledges the BJP's dominance under Modi but suggests that the Gandhis have aided his consolidation.

recent_articles.title: Delay in statehood restoration, local body polls hurting public interest in J-K: Congress
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Jammu and Kashmir Congress** expressed concern over the delay in restoring full statehood, elections to grassroots democratic institutions, and addressing various public issues.  **Raman Bhalla**, JKPCC working president, highlighted the negative impact of these delays on governance, accountability, and development. recent_articles.title: Black flags waived, called ‘thief’: TMC MP Kalyan Banerjee claims BJP supporters attacked him outside police station | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalyan Banerjee**, a **Trinamool Congress (TMC)** MP, alleged he was attacked by a crowd outside a police station in West Bengal's Hooghly district while protesting the arrest of party workers. recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following an attack on **Abhishek Banerjee**, the MP for Diamond Harbour, during a visit to Sonarpur in South 24 Parganas district, **TMC** and **BJP** have blamed each other.
